name: pulso
description: Pulso — jornal diário de IA em português: cozinha de edição (feeds, modelos, checagens) e site estático

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.build:site: node scripts/rasterize-og.mjs && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build:ssr --workspace=frontend && node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/rasterize-covers.mjs && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend && npm run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
